# pnp-search API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Run explicit SharePoint searches and suggestions with native server refinement tokens.

## SPFxPnPSearchOptions

Defaults for explicit search requests. Individual builders may override selected properties/refiners; service paging is applied afterward.

### Imports

```ts
import type { SPFxPnPSearchOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxPnPSearchOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Examples

```ts
import { SPFxPnPSearchOptions } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

const options: SPFxPnPSearchOptions = { pageSize: 25, selectProperties: ['Title', 'Path'], refiners: 'FileType' };
```

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxPnPSearchOptions.pageSize` | `number \| undefined` | Optional | 50 | Default row limit; omitted uses 50. Request pageSize takes precedence. |
| `SPFxPnPSearchOptions.refinerOperator` | `"and" \| "or" \| undefined` | Optional | 'and' | How multiple selected values within each managed property are combined.<br>`and` requires every selected value; `or` accepts any selected value.<br>Different managed properties always combine with AND; empty value arrays add no restriction and property names are never remapped.<br>Omitted or undefined uses and. |
| `SPFxPnPSearchOptions.refiners` | `string \| undefined` | Optional | — | Comma-separated managed-property refiner specification; omitted requests no additional refiners. |
| `SPFxPnPSearchOptions.selectProperties` | `string[] \| undefined` | Optional | — | Managed properties requested by default; omitted/empty retains PnP/SharePoint defaults. |

## SPFxPnPSearchRefiner

### Imports (3)


```ts
import { SPFxPnPSearchRefiner, SPFxPnPSearchResponse } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
```

## SPFxPnPSearchRequestOptions

### Members (4)

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxPnPSearchRequestOptions.pageSize` | `number \| undefined` | Optional | — | Overrides the service row limit, including any builder rowLimit; omitted or undefined uses service pageSize or 50. |
| `SPFxPnPSearchRequestOptions.refinementFilters` | `Map<string, string[]> \| undefined` | Optional | — | Managed property names mapped to refinement tokens from response entries.<br>Omitted or empty adds no request filters. Use each entry's `token`, not its display `value`. Tokens already enclosed<br>in FQL double quotes, native scalars and FQL expressions such as `range(...)`<br>are preserved without equals wrapping. Unquoted hex tokens are quoted once. Numeric/date scalars remain unchanged, and SharePoint validates native FQL expressions. Legacy unquoted text<br>values retain escaped string-equality filtering. |
| `SPFxPnPSearchRequestOptions.refinerOperator` | `"and" \| "or" \| undefined` | Optional | The service default, or 'and' when unspecified | Overrides the service's within-property selection operator for this request.<br>Different managed properties always combine with AND; empty value arrays add no restriction and property names are never remapped.<br>Omitted or undefined uses the service default, or and. |
| `SPFxPnPSearchRequestOptions.startRow` | `number \| undefined` | Optional | — | Positive row offset applied after the builder; omitted/zero does not override a builder offset. |

## createSPFxPnPSearchService

Creates a SharePoint search service with native refiner token support. Construction makes no request; caller owns authentication. Registers search/suggestion only, with no cache, automatic retry or React state.

### Imports (8)

```ts
import { createSPFxPnPSearchService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { createSPFxPnPSearchService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Use when

- You need explicit SharePoint search, suggestions or server refinement tokens outside React.

### Examples (8)

#### Basic usage

```ts
import type { SPFI } from '@pnp/sp';
import { createSPFxPnPSearchService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(sp: SPFI) {
  const service = createSPFxPnPSearchService(sp, {
    refiners: 'FileType,Size', refinerOperator: 'or'
  });
  const response = await service.search('*');
  const type = response.refiners.find(refiner => refiner.name === 'FileType');
  if (type?.entries.length) {
    await service.search('*', {
      refinementFilters: new Map([['FileType', type.entries.map(entry => entry.token)]])
    });
  }
}
```

#### Apply a returned PDF refiner token

```ts
import type { SPFI } from '@pnp/sp';

import { createSPFxPnPSearchService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
async function demonstrate(sp: SPFI) {
  const service = createSPFxPnPSearchService(sp, {
    refiners: 'FileType,DisplayAuthor,Size,Write', refinerOperator: 'or'
  });
  const response = await service.search('*');
  const fileType = response.refiners.find(refiner => refiner.name === 'FileType');
  const pdf = fileType?.entries.find(entry => entry.value === 'pdf');
  if (pdf?.token) {
    await service.search('*', {
      refinementFilters: new Map([['FileType', [pdf.token]]])
    });
  }
}
```

#### Search a typed page and request suggestions

```ts
import type { SPFI } from '@pnp/sp';

import { createSPFxPnPSearchService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
async function demonstrate(sp: SPFI) {
  const search = createSPFxPnPSearchService<{ Title: string; Path: string }>(sp, {
    pageSize: 25, selectProperties: ['Title', 'Path'],
  });
  const page = await search.search(builder => builder.text('training'), { startRow: 25 });
  const suggestions = await search.suggest('train');
  console.log(page.results[0]?.data.Title, suggestions);
}
```
